name: Little Rock AFB
description: Home of the 19th Airlift Wing, Little Rock AFB is the Department of Defense's premier C-130 Hercules training and airlift hub. The installation trains aircrews from across the Air Force and allied nations while supporting global mobility operations from central Arkansas.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate. All visitors must obtain a visitor pass — Trusted Traveler Program suspended. 100% ID checks enforced until further notice.

gates.name: Vandenberg Gate (Main Gate)
gates.notes: Primary 24/7 gate. After-hours visitor passes issued at Bldg 1502 (gate guard building). Trusted Traveler Program suspended — all visitors require a pass.
gates.address: Vandenberg Blvd, Little Rock AFB, AR 72099

gates.name: Arnold Gate (Back Gate)

gates.name: Harris Road Gate (School Gate)

gates.name: Marshall Road Gate

primaryAction.title: Little Rock AFB Visitor Control Center
primaryAction.address: Bldg 1508, Vandenberg Blvd, Little Rock AFB, AR 72099

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: Bring PCS orders, CAC, medical and dental records, and marriage or birth certificates if applicable. Carry finance and travel receipts for settlement.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your Unit Command Support Staff (CSS) normal business hours (Mon-Fri 0730-1630). Attend the newcomers briefing at the Military & Family Readiness Center. Visit Finance for travel voucher settlement.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact the Housing Management Office before arrival. All personnel must visit HMO before signing any off-base lease. Razorback Inn offers temporary lodging — book early during PCS season.

sections.title: Gate Access
sections.body: Vandenberg Gate is open 24/7. Arnold Gate is Mon-Fri 0500-2200 and Sat-Sun 0600-1800. Harris Road (School Gate) is Mon-Fri 0600-0830 and 1430-1630. Visitor Control Center hours are Mon-Fri 0600-1630. REAL ID required. Trusted Traveler suspended.

sections.body: Official installation resources plus Military OneSource and BaseDirectory for relocation support.
